name: Grand Velas Riviera Nayarit
positioning: All-inclusive beach resort on Banderas Bay in Nuevo Vallarta, on the Puerto Vallarta coast, with contemporary Mexican architecture
best_for: Families wanting kids' and teens' clubs within an all-inclusive stay
Couples who want an all-inclusive with French, Italian, Mexican and Asian dinners
Travelers flying into Puerto Vallarta who want a short transfer

facts.text: The resort sits on Banderas Bay on the Puerto Vallarta coast, with white sand beaches.
The address is Av. Cocoteros 98 Sur, Nuevo Vallarta, Nayarit.
The resort is designed with contemporary Mexican architecture and tropical landscapes.
Suite terraces look out to the ocean and the Sierra Madre Mountains.
Dinner is a la carte at four signature restaurants: Frida for gourmet Mexican, Piaf for traditional French, Lucca for Italian-Mediterranean and Sen Lin for Asian fusion.
The all-inclusive package covers all the gourmet restaurants, the bars, the poolside swim-up bar and room service.
The executive chef is French-born Guillaume Morance.
The resort has an infinity pool and a kids pool.
All taxes and gratuities are included in the all-inclusive amenities.
The Teens' Club has video gaming booths with big screens, a pool table, foosball and air hockey.
The Kids' Club is split into Kids' Club Garden for children 4 and up and Kids' Club Terrace for kids 6 to 12.
Nighttime entertainment includes fire shows, and live music plays in an open-air amphitheater.

highlights.text: A Digital Detox program has the concierge take the television out of the suite, replace it with classic board games and whisk guests' personal devices away to a safe.
Arriving guests are greeted in the lobby with a hibiscus infusion, a scented towel and a relaxing massage.
The restaurants are reached along breezy corridors with colorful plants and koi ponds.
Suites have private terraces with teak furniture imported from Bali.
The Grand Class Suite has an oceanfront location and a jacuzzi on the terrace.

considerations.text: Puerto Vallarta International Airport is about a 20-minute drive in normal traffic, and the resort's airport transfer costs extra.
Spa treatments are not part of the all-inclusive and cost extra, and the fitness center is for guests 16 and over.
WhataHotel notes that the large resort may feel less intimate.
